description: This Java class 'EnvironmentClassifier' probes the OrangeHRM application's URL to determine the runtime environment's health and classification status. It performs lightweight HTTP health checks, assesses the application's reachability, database connectivity status, and supports simulation modes for testing purposes.

classes.name: EnvironmentState
classes.description: Enumeration of possible environment states detected by the classifier, including app reachability and database health status.

classes.name: ClassificationResult
classes.description: Immutable class representing the result of an environment classification, including state, diagnostics, and duration.

methods.name: classify
methods.description: Main public method that probes the environment and classifies its current state.

methods.name: isSimulationMode
methods.description: Checks if the environment probing is in simulation mode based on system properties or environment variables.

methods.name: formatSummary
methods.description: Generates a human-readable summary of a given classification result.
